newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere says still wants Thomson.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere says still wants Thomson.

text.p: Lagardere Groupe on Wednesday reaffirmed its interest in buying state electronics firm Thomson SA after the government said it was suspending the sell-off on the advice of the privatisation commission.
The government had preferred Lagardere's bid for Thomson over an offer by Alcatel but the commission said it could not approve part of Lagardere's offer.
